description: Shared vectors of Money (Ruby and JS), skeleton of W2-0: the cases below are certain; the track T8 adds the rest (including the mutants of a wrong answer) before it builds the functions. 'args' are strings as the schema holds them; 'result' is the canonical output.

round_half_up.doc: An amount rounded to cents, half up.

vat.doc: The VAT of an amount at a rate in percent, rounded half up.

row.doc: One invoice row: quantity times price.

invoice.doc: All rows of an invoice from its data; ERROR_VARIANTS is the closed list of typical errors.
